name: images/logos-transgan-projected-dinov3-128

args.source:
# Reduced-depth TransGAN-style 128px generator; one latent [B,128], no extra noise.
# Two transformer blocks per stage instead of depths 5/4/4/4/4.
# Parameter-free PixelNorm and learned 2D relative-position bias via native HNDL.
# Linear projections use explicit PyTorch defaults: Kaiming-uniform weights
# with a=sqrt(5), and biases uniform in +/-1/sqrt(fan_in). The official
# generator leaves Linear initialization unchanged; only its RGB convolution
# gets Xavier weights. Our equivalent tokenwise RGB linear uses Xavier too.
# Position tables use truncated_normal(std=0.02), default bounds [-2,2].
# Separate Q/K/V retain the combined matrix fan-in; random draw layout differs.
# Reduced depth, latent size, and the surrounding training recipe are adaptations.
# Reference architecture: https://arxiv.org/html/2102.07074v4#A2.T6
# Learned absolute positions precede grid partitioning at 64px and 128px.
# Global attention at 8/16/32px; shared 16x16-window attention at 64/128px.
h = linear(x, 65536, name="input_projection", init={"weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "bias": uniform(a=-0.08838834764831843, b=0.08838834764831843)})
h = reshape(h, 64, 1024)
h = pos_embed(h, 64, name="stage8_position", init={"weight": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage8_block0_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(8, 8), name="stage8_block0_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage8_block0_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage8_block0_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 4096, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage8_block0_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.015625, b=0.015625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage8_block0")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage8_block1_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(8, 8), name="stage8_block1_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage8_block1_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage8_block1_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 4096, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage8_block1_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.015625, b=0.015625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage8_block1")

# Bicubic enlargement preserves 1024 channels, 8px -> 16px.
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 1024, 8, 8)
h = upsample(h, 2, mode="bicubic", align_corners=False, name="stage16_upsample")
h = reshape(h, 1024, 256)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = pos_embed(h, 256, name="stage16_position", init={"weight": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage16_block0_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage16_block0_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage16_block0_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage16_block0_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 4096, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage16_block0_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.015625, b=0.015625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage16_block0")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage16_block1_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage16_block1_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage16_block1_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage16_block1_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 4096, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage16_block1_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.015625, b=0.015625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage16_block1")

# Pixel shuffle: 16px/1024 channels -> 32px/256 channels.
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 1024, 16, 16)
h = pixel_shuffle(h, 2, name="stage32_upsample")
h = reshape(h, 256, 1024)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = pos_embed(h, 1024, name="stage32_position", init={"weight": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage32_block0_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(32, 32), name="stage32_block0_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage32_block0_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage32_block0_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 1024, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage32_block0_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage32_block0")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage32_block1_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(32, 32), name="stage32_block1_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage32_block1_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage32_block1_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 1024, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage32_block1_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.03125, b=0.03125)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage32_block1")

h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 256, 32, 32)

# Pixel shuffle: 32px/256 channels -> 64px/64 channels.
h = pixel_shuffle(h, 2, name="stage64_upsample")
h = reshape(h, 64, 4096)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = pos_embed(h, 4096, name="stage64_position", init={"weight": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 64, 64, 64, name="stage64_grid")

# BEGIN grid64
# BEGIN stage64 window partition: [B,C,64,64] -> [16*B,C,16,16].
row0, row1, row2, row3 = chunk(h, 4, dim=2, name="stage64_row_split")
rows = concat(row0, row1, row2, row3, axis=0, name="stage64_rows")
column0, column1, column2, column3 = chunk(rows, 4, dim=3, name="stage64_column_split")
h = concat(column0, column1, column2, column3, axis=0, name="stage64_windows")
# END stage64 window partition.

h = reshape(h, 64, 256)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage64_block0_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage64_block0_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage64_block0_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage64_block0_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 256, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage64_block0_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage64_block0")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage64_block1_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage64_block1_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage64_block1_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage64_block1_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 256, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage64_block1_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.0625, b=0.0625)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage64_block1")
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 64, 16, 16, name="stage64_processed_windows")

# BEGIN stage64 window inverse: [16*B,C,16,16] -> [B,C,64,64].
column0, column1, column2, column3 = chunk(h, 4, dim=0, name="stage64_column_unstack")
rows = concat(column0, column1, column2, column3, axis=3, name="stage64_columns_restored")
row0, row1, row2, row3 = chunk(rows, 4, dim=0, name="stage64_row_unstack")
h = concat(row0, row1, row2, row3, axis=2, name="stage64_unwindows")
# END stage64 window inverse.
# END grid64

# Pixel shuffle: 64px/64 channels -> 128px/16 channels.
h = pixel_shuffle(h, 2, name="stage128_upsample")
h = reshape(h, 16, 16384)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = pos_embed(h, 16384, name="stage128_position", init={"weight": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 16, 128, 128, name="stage128_grid")

# BEGIN grid128
# BEGIN stage128 window partition: [B,C,128,128] -> [64*B,C,16,16].
row0, row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6, row7 = chunk(h, 8, dim=2, name="stage128_row_split")
rows = concat(row0, row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6, row7, axis=0, name="stage128_rows")
column0, column1, column2, column3, column4, column5, column6, column7 = chunk(rows, 8, dim=3, name="stage128_column_split")
h = concat(column0, column1, column2, column3, column4, column5, column6, column7, axis=0, name="stage128_windows")
# END stage128 window partition.

h = reshape(h, 16, 256)
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage128_block0_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage128_block0_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.25, b=0.25),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage128_block0_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage128_block0_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 64, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage128_block0_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.25, b=0.25),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage128_block0")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage128_block1_norm1")
branch = attention(branch, 4, dropout=0.0, qkv_bias=False, out_bias=True,
    relative_position_bias=True, spatial_shape=(16, 16), name="stage128_block1_attention",
    init={"q_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "k_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "v_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979),
          "o_proj.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "o_proj.bias": uniform(a=-0.25, b=0.25),
          "relative_position_bias_table": truncated_normal(std=0.02)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage128_block1_attention_residual")
branch = rms_norm(h, eps=1e-8, affine=False, name="stage128_block1_norm2")
branch = feed_forward(branch, 64, activation="gelu", dropout=0.0, name="stage128_block1_ffn",
    init={"up.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "up.bias": uniform(a=-0.25, b=0.25),
          "down.weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979), "down.bias": uniform(a=-0.125, b=0.125)})
h = add(h, branch, name="stage128_block1")
h = transpose(h, 1, 2)
h = reshape(h, 16, 16, 16, name="stage128_processed_windows")

# BEGIN stage128 window inverse: [64*B,C,16,16] -> [B,C,128,128].
column0, column1, column2, column3, column4, column5, column6, column7 = chunk(h, 8, dim=0, name="stage128_column_unstack")
rows = concat(column0, column1, column2, column3, column4, column5, column6, column7, axis=3, name="stage128_columns_restored")
row0, row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6, row7 = chunk(rows, 8, dim=0, name="stage128_row_unstack")
h = concat(row0, row1, row2, row3, row4, row5, row6, row7, axis=2, name="stage128_unwindows")
# END stage128 window inverse.
# END grid128

# Shared tokenwise RGB projection; permute explicitly declares the sequence rank.
h = reshape(h, 16, 16384)
h = permute(h, 2, 1)
h = linear(h, 3, name="output_projection", init={"weight": xavier_uniform(), "bias": uniform(a=-0.25, b=0.25)})
h = permute(h, 2, 1)
h = reshape(h, 3, 128, 128)
out = tanh(h)

# 128px DINOv3 Projected GAN critic. Input RGB in [-1, 1].
# Sauer et al., ICLR 2022: frozen feature network, fixed CCM, and independent
# spectral discriminators. One candidate image and one backbone call.
# No gray context and no second copy of the image.
# ViT-S/16 blocks 2, 5, 8, and 11 are all native 8x8 maps. ViT features are
# not a CNN pyramid. There is no higher-resolution feature map to skip-add,
# so there is no CSM U-Net.
# No pixel/RGB branch: the paper's ablation found that it hurt.
# The four 4x4 logit maps stay concatenated. Logistic loss and b-cap reduce
# them outside this graph.

# ImageNet normalization of [-1, 1] RGB: (x * 0.5 + 0.5 - mean) / std.
scaled = scale(x, 0.5)
half = constant(x, 3, 1, 1, value=0.5)
normalized = broadcast_add(scaled, half)
red, green_blue = split(normalized, 1)
green, blue = split(green_blue, 1)
red_bias = constant(red, 1, 1, 1, value=-0.485)
red = broadcast_add(red, red_bias)
red = scale(red, 4.3668122270742355)
green_bias = constant(green, 1, 1, 1, value=-0.456)
green = broadcast_add(green, green_bias)
green = scale(green, 4.464285714285714)
blue_bias = constant(blue, 1, 1, 1, value=-0.406)
blue = broadcast_add(blue, blue_bias)
blue = scale(blue, 4.444444444444445)
normalized = concat(red, green, blue, name="normalized")

# Frozen ViT-S/16. The readout returns blocks 2, 5, 8, and 11 concatenated
# on channels: [B, 1536, 8, 8]. The batch is B, not 2B.
features = pretrained(normalized, ${weights_path},
    provider="dinov3_vits16", sha256=${weights_sha256},
    readout="multidepth", trainable=False, name="backbone")
feature1, remaining = split(features, 384, name="depth1_split")
feature2, remaining = split(remaining, 384, name="depth2_split")
feature3, feature4 = split(remaining, 384, name="depth3_split")

# CCM: one frozen 1x1 per map, 384 to 384, no bias and no activation.
# Kaiming uniform with a=sqrt(5) is the PyTorch convolution default.
ccm1 = conv(feature1, 384, kernel_size=1, bias=False, trainable=False, name="ccm1", init={"weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979)})
ccm2 = conv(feature2, 384, kernel_size=1, bias=False, trainable=False, name="ccm2", init={"weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979)})
ccm3 = conv(feature3, 384, kernel_size=1, bias=False, trainable=False, name="ccm3", init={"weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979)})
ccm4 = conv(feature4, 384, kernel_size=1, bias=False, trainable=False, name="ccm4", init={"weight": kaiming_uniform(a=2.23606797749979)})

# Four independent spectral discriminators. Each 8x8 map emits 4x4 logits.
# No shared weights, batch norm, final activation, flatten, or linear.
h1 = conv(ccm1, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1, stride=2, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc1_down")
h1 = leaky_relu(h1, 0.2)
logit1 = conv(h1, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc1_logit")

h2 = conv(ccm2, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1, stride=2, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc2_down")
h2 = leaky_relu(h2, 0.2)
logit2 = conv(h2, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc2_logit")

h3 = conv(ccm3, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1, stride=2, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc3_down")
h3 = leaky_relu(h3, 0.2)
logit3 = conv(h3, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc3_logit")

h4 = conv(ccm4, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1, stride=2, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc4_down")
h4 = leaky_relu(h4, 0.2)
logit4 = conv(h4, 1, kernel_size=3, padding=1, spectral_norm=True, bias=False, name="disc4_logit")

out = concat(logit1, logit2, logit3, logit4)
